reviewItem.question: Does "Requeue on poll interval, not pipeline TTL, when RTC is disabled by @negz in https://github.com/crossplane/crossplane/pull/6619" mean a change to protocol-behavior:crossplane|name=requeue-poll-interval-not-pipeline-ttl (behavior-changed)?

proposed.statement: When realtime compositions (RTC) is disabled, Crossplane now requeues on the poll interval instead of the pipeline TTL.
